title: HustleBox v1.0.2 — Quality of Life
message:
A pile of polish. The food truck shift now opens with a real "OPEN" sign drop and Ray actually says something. There's a chalkboard menu with prices. Ending a shift now plays a proper close-out — Marcus walks home through the empty streets and you see how the night went.

• Theatrical shift opening: day counter, OPEN sign drops in, Ray reacts to your reputation
• Chalkboard menu board with item names and prices ($2–$7)
• End-of-shift overlay with a walking-home animation and shift summary
• Profile redesigned — hero card with rank badges, story that evolves with progress, compact stats grid (no more spreadsheet)
• Toggles: smoother iOS-style spring animation, white knob with shadow
• Back buttons added to Settings, News, Achievements, and Profile sub-screens
• Removed: Reduce Motion setting (nothing in-game uses it), Username field (no longer editable)
• Account section now shows "Create Account (Coming Soon)" instead of "Cloud Save"

No gameplay rebalancing this version. All saves carry forward.
